The paper's goal is Theorem A, so a Part II of EllipticCurveModularity is the right direction, beside its accepted sibling Part IIs. The brief gives the final theorems and makes the design state that it re-proves R27.6's and R29.6's statements rather than re-planning them. It conflated the I₃-condition of Theorems 2.1.2 and 2.1.4 with the G₃-condition of Theorem 2.1.6, which is now fixed. Its imports now name the owners of σ_τ (route 7), Tate's theorem (R07.1), Ekedahl's theorem (IG.2) and local Tate duality (Tau Ceti ClassFieldTheory layer 5).

The two designs must settle one owner, and the finite flat group scheme roadmap is the foundational choice.

The functors D^S with tangent spaces H¹_S are local conditions of the kind R08.6 exports. 'Weakly of type' and '(weakly) acceptable' are the missing refinements.

Accept. They are now missing and routed with R30.2, the smooth mod-p category of GL₂(Q_p).

notes: Independent review by Claude Code, session cc-f805bf (29 September 2026), of the extraction by Claude Code cc-fb70e5 (issue #4510); cc-f805bf appears nowhere in the extraction's files. The published PDF was read from the Internet Archive's copy of the AMS URL (https://web.archive.org/web/2023id_/https://www.ams.org/journals/jams/2001-14-04/S0894-0347-01-00370-8/S0894-0347-01-00370-8.pdf); the AMS site itself served a Cloudflare challenge. The copy has 97 pp. and SHA-256 1e34130e…4cf2, matching the recorded hash. Breuil's author copy (https://www.imo.universite-paris-saclay.fr/~breuil/PUBLICATIONS/STW.pdf, 80 pp.) was compared at every misprint and repeats all twelve. The whole text was read, §§1–10; the reviewer did not redo most of the Breuil-module computations of §§7–9, only those behind E9–E11 and the §3 admittance counts for τ₁ and τ′_i. All 88 numbered statements of the paper appear in item locators with the right pages, except [CDT]'s Theorem 6.1.1, which is cited only. Eight sourceIssues (E1–E8) were confirmed on 300-dpi page images. Four misprints were added and confirmed: E9 (§6.4 uniformiser α/β for (α − 1)/β), E10 (§7.4 γ̂₃(e₁)), E11 (proof of Lemma 7.2.6) and E12 (Theorem 4.6.3, ρ for ρ_N). Crossref lists no update. Corrections in place: two item statements (descent-data cocycle, uniformiser of F′₋₃); five planned→missing statuses (breuil-modules, thm-5-1-3, thm-5-6-1, mod-l-reps-compact, conj-1-3-1), after reading R07.4, R07.5 and R30.5; two added missing items for cited theorems the proofs rest on (Tate [T, Thm. 4]; Ekedahl [E, Thm. 1.3]); route 7 re-targeted to SmoothRepresentationsPartII; route 8 now names R30.2; route 9 added; route 1's brief corrected. No item has library status, and a search of the pinned declaration index (Breuil, Barsotti–Tate, p-divisible, descent datum, Weil–Deligne, deformation, Hilbert irreducibility, Serre weight, Langlands–Tunnell) found nothing that provides an item. The partial infrastructure it did find (Cartier duality of finite locally free group schemes, Mathlib's groupCohomology, the complex GL₂(F_q) character table) provides none of them. Every cited layer's description was read. The remaining planned citations hold: R19.1, R26.1, R27.6, R29.6, R07.1 (closure), R07.4 (descent data), R08.3 and R08.6. scripts/check_paper.py passes.
